subject: Air freight quote request – RUH and GRU
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option for each of these two shipments? Both are ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in 20674 Hamburg, Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport.

1. Destination airport RUH (Riyadh, SA): sports equipment, 6 pieces, gross weight 591 kg, volume 1.95 cbm.
2. Destination airport GRU (Sao Paulo, BR): machine parts, 6 pieces, gross weight 1335 kg, volume 10.63 cbm.

Please send both quotes in the same reply, with a separate all-in price in EUR for each shipment rather than a combined price.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting new air freight quotes for two shipments.
